# build config URI

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:buildConfigUri`](gmeow-buildConfigUri.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/buildConfigUri>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The URI of the build configuration or workflow file that describes the build process — e.g. the URL of `.github/workflows/release.yml` or a Jenkinsfile.
